reason: Historical pre-v9 reconciliation: the v126 runner replaced suites written for removed v58/v60/v61 DOM and copy. The current public v9 replacements are recorded under v9PublicMigration; original suites remain as references.

replacements.home-handoff: home-v126: sample heading parity, section order, scores, navigation, FAQ, no-JS and motion. Old barcard drawing choreography and old copy are obsolete.
replacements.home-audit: home-v126 plus hero-viewport: current section order, responsive bounds, scores, controls and fallback. v58 dark-section adjacency is obsolete.
replacements.proof-responsive: home-v126: all four preset scores/verdicts, fixed candidate evidence, range interactions, aria state and responsive clipping.
replacements.home-operations: home-v126: current sample headings and content clipping. Legacy operations geometry is obsolete.
replacements.home-savings: home-v126: current sample headings and content clipping. Legacy savings card geometry is obsolete.
replacements.v61-approvals: home-v126: v126 sample heading and section parity. v61 exact copy approval assertions are obsolete.
replacements.v60-copy: home-v126: current sample heading parity and lead. v60 exact copy is obsolete.
replacements.experts-layout: home-v126: twelve expert areas, responsive clipping and current section parity. v58 expert-card layout is obsolete.
replacements.funnel-stages: home-v126: all stage counts, keyboard selection and protection against autoplay overwriting user selection. v58 selectors obsolete.

adaptations.hero-viewport: Current hero, cue, client strip and proof selectors; retain adjacency, content bounds, no-JS and overflow checks. Exact viewport-height locking was a v58 design requirement and is removed.
adaptations.home-enquiry: Follow current hero anchor to start CTA, then retain dialog focus trap, validation, provider error/retry, stale request/timer and focus restoration assertions.
adaptations.client-publication: Current client track groups names into two spans; retain exact ordered names and single ARIA exposure.
adaptations.reviewed-bugs: Replace v58 weight instruction/calculation copy checks with nine weight controls, static score/thresholds and interactive v126 preset; retain all non-home checks. Industries comparison chart was also removed before v9; assert all twelve unique visible sector destinations and hiring CTA in enabled, disabled and blocked-script modes instead. Candidate v7 uses #sScore and .pre2; preserve independent weighted-score verification and inactive-control requirement. Removed old explanatory copy selectors are obsolete. No-JS inactive controls remain a potential real failure, not waived.
adaptations.content-typography: Preserve family/size/leading/weight/tracking checks with explicit current version scales: home v126 sample.css (including ops/proc headings), candidate-v7.css, and current industries hero. Shared editorial tokens continue on other routes; no automatic snapshot acceptance.

limits: Historical baseline reconciliation does not certify current v9 acceptance. v9PublicMigration records current public coverage; private v9 suites and independent visual reviews remain required.

v9PublicMigration.reason: All public content routes now use V9Layout. The pre-v9 public journey and text suites assert superseded layouts, selectors and font scales.

coverage.tests/v9-public-routes.test.mjs: Promoted v9 pages: canonical/index metadata, contextual links, responsive bounds, keyboard interactions and no-JS.
coverage.tests/v9-content-pages.test.mjs: Every remaining public content route at mobile/desktop sizes: v9 fonts and shell, route retention, filters, comparison charts, native application dialog, mocked form success/retry, no-JS content.
coverage.tests/shared-chrome.test.mjs: All built public pages have one shared shell; responsive header/footer consistency, navigation, legal metadata and no overflow.
coverage.tests/client-publication.test.mjs: Approved v9 customer names, including explicitly approved Heineken, ARIA duplicate suppression, responsive and no-JS rendering.
coverage.tests/built-links.test.mjs: Every built link resolves to a static target or an existing Netlify handler; publication exclusions, article reading times, sitemap and robots.
coverage.tests/newsletter-journey.test.mjs: Retained newsletter waitlist delivery contract on the blog index and an existing article, using mocked responses.
coverage.tests/v9-release-regressions.test.mjs: Chart widths and contrast, mobile labels, upload validation/payload/error/retry/success/focus/state, no-JS alternatives, native sharing and single topic navigation.
coverage.tests/v9-content-journeys.test.mjs: Dropped location across all built pages, eight-article discovery/metadata, real related destinations, mocked notification journey, example context and policy revision hierarchy.
coverage.tests/v9-sharing.test.mjs: All eight articles at mobile/tablet/desktop sizes: shared icon controls, footer alignment, utility typography, correct share URLs, clipboard success/denial, keyboard focus and native no-JavaScript links.

v9PublicMigration.preserved: Original historical suites remain in tests; v9 preview, A1, A2, sector, unit and static gates remain required. Production artifacts run on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
